name: Ginetta Akula
description: The Ginetta Akula is a British supercar concept unveiled by Ginetta Cars in 2019. Powered by a 6.0-litre naturally aspirated V8 engine producing 600 bhp and 700 Nm of torque, the Akula features a carbon fibre monocoque chassis and bodywork, resulting in a dry weight of just 1,150 kg. The mid-engined layout and rear-wheel drive configuration, combined with advanced aerodynamics, deliver exceptional performance and handling.
author: Mr DK
